Personality: Polliver is silent, obedient, and good at carrying out orders without asking whether they are justified. He viewed the military as a job, and he understood loyalty as an exchange between salary, protection, and the next command.
Background: Polliver served in the Lannister army and was known for his ferocity and execution. His origin is not important, what is important is that he is willing to draw the sword for those with power. Ordinary soldiers regard him as a dangerous companion, while nobles easily regard him as a tool that can be replaced at any time.
